title: pvElevation
body:
## pvElevation

Adds a floating-point point array named Elevation by projecting each point onto the segment from LowPoint to HighPoint and mapping its position linearly into ScalarRange: the LowPoint end gets the first value, the HighPoint end the second, and points beyond either end are clamped. Use it for height colouring, a linear test ramp or a coordinate along any direction; elevation is the curated version and pvCellGridElevation works on cell grids.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Points beyond the segment all receive the end values; extend LowPoint and HighPoint over the data if the full variation is wanted.
- LowPoint and HighPoint may receive input-dependent ParaView defaults; set them explicitly.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `Elevation`. Identity: `filters/ElevationFilter`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input dataset to the Elevation filter. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `HighPoint` | This property defines the high end of the direction vector (large scalar values). | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `LowPoint` | This property defines low end of the direction vector (small scalar values). | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `ScalarRange` | This property determines the range into which scalars will be mapped. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":2,"minItems":2,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1]` |

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json

  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvElevation",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
